known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Confirmation of who is on the line: only explicit confirmations count; ask at most twice (answering a customer question first does not reset the count), then close not_reached/unclear. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Declining identity questions: explain once that they protect the account; a second refusal or a second 'what is this about' question closes not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Interpret 'next <weekday>' as the weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as the one in the current week, relative to now. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Persuasion attempts: each flat refusal or non-answer (including refusing the deadline after a too-late date, or refusing the floor) consumes one attempt; band attempts limit (1 early, 2 late); never repeat a refused offer; then close no_promise/refused. Customer-proposed dates/amounts never count as refusals. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Floor is offered once after 'too much' or a below-floor amount; track whether the customer already said the full amount is too much so attempt 1 uses the floor. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Hardship takes precedence over persuasion and restructuring: one sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer support transfer; but a self-named date/amount is still recorded under sections 7 and 8. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Human request: ask once whether you can help first; transfer to general only if they insist. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Customer saying twice they do not want to talk: close no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage closing): If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason rather than promise. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
checks: first security answer reaches verify_identity with the right field
no account or write call before verification
negotiation stage reached with account facts
every product's past-due amount stated in the debt statement, before any offer
